error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
rejection_placeholder: Explain why this application is rejected… (the applicant will receive this reason)
allow_reply_hint: Off: the applicant reads your messages but cannot reply. On: they can write while their application is open.
placeholder_candidate: Message sent to the applicant (email + notification)…
candidate_will_be_emailed: The applicant will be notified by email and in-app.
already_agreed: Already agreed with the applicant (confirm directly)
interview_message_placeholder: Message for the applicant (topics, preparation…) — optional
confirm_cancel_interview: Cancel this interview? The applicant will be notified.
report_placeholder: Interview report (saved as an internal note)…
evaluation_private: Private evaluation, never visible to the applicant.
phone_will_call: The team will call you at the scheduled time.
decline_placeholder: Tell us your availability or the reason (optional)…
replies_closed: The team has not opened replies for now. You will be notified by email of any new message.
room_not_found: This room does not exist or the link is incorrect.
room_waiting: The room opens at {{time}} (30 minutes before the start). This page updates automatically.
room_unconfirmed: This interview is not confirmed yet.
room_hint: Allow camera and microphone when your browser asks.
open_in_new_tab: Open in a new tab if you have trouble
ask_to_complete: Ask the applicant to complete this field
request_pending: Additional information awaiting the applicant's reply
request_sent: Request sent: the applicant is notified by email and in-app.
request_title: Ask the applicant for more information
request_hint: Tick the fields above (or click “Missing fields”). The applicant will see a form limited to these fields.
request_message_placeholder: Message for the applicant (optional): expected details, deadline…
complete_hint: The team needs this information to review your application.
list_hint: Separate with commas (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, AWS)
reopen_confirm_accepted:
Set this application back under review?

The user's role does not change, but the application will no longer be “approved” until you approve it again.
reopen_confirm_rejected: Set this application back under review? The applicant will be able to exchange and complete the file again.
closed_accepted_hint: Application approved. You can reopen it to review it again.
closed_rejected_hint: Application rejected. You can reopen it to review it again.
other_placeholder: Other (free text) — press Enter to add
cv_choose: Click or drag your CV here
cv_hint: PDF, DOC or DOCX — 5 MB maximum
cv_required: Upload a file to answer this request.
cv_upload_failed: Your application is saved, but the CV could not be uploaded. You can upload it when the team asks for it.
